'''Guwa''', also spelt '''Goa''', '''Koa''', and other variants, is an extinct and nearly unattested [[Australian Aboriginal language]] of [[Queensland]] spoken by the [[Koa people]]. It was apparently close to [[Yanda language|Yanda]].<ref name="AIATSIS" />

== Dialects ==
Guwa had a western and eastern dialect differentiation.<ref name=":0" />
